scenes.title: Talking to the Fish and Calling the Oligarch
scenes.summary: Barinov consults his fish Arkady about retiring for his health, calls oligarch Alyokhin to accept his offer, and Lyova walks Gulya home from the cinema.

scenes.title: Elena's Book and the Decision to Fight
scenes.summary: When Elena reveals she published a cookbook, Barinov's pride makes him reverse his decision to quit and announce a new auteur menu to win a Michelin star.

scenes.title: Presenting the Auteur Cuisine
scenes.summary: Barinov turns down the oligarch's offer and announces to his stunned chefs that the restaurant is switching to Viktor Barinov's auteur cuisine.

scenes.title: Tiny Portions and High Prices
scenes.summary: Nikita asks to keep the old menu when he hears the five-thousand-ruble prices, but Barinov throws out the old menus and orders his chefs to study the new recipes.

scenes.title: Ainura's Advice About the Kiss
scenes.summary: Ainura urges shy Lyova to stop hesitating and kiss Gulya, while Senya eavesdrops on their conversation and teases Lyova.

scenes.title: Pricy Pigeons and a Plan for the Evening
scenes.summary: A guest leaves over the high menu prices, and both Denis and Nikita independently plan to reconcile with Katya at the evening party.

scenes.title: Sage in the Galantine and the Prefect's Visit
scenes.summary: Barinov scolds Senya for altering his recipe, and when Nastya reports that the district prefect wants ribs, Barinov goes out to persuade him to try the new auteur menu.

scenes.title: Clash with the Prefect
scenes.summary: The prefect insults Barinov's haute cuisine portions and tries to leave without paying, leading to a heated confrontation.

scenes.title: A Toast to the New Menu
scenes.summary: Barinov makes peace with Mikhail over a toast to the new menu and Michelin star, while Kostya tells Nikita and Denis that Katya is on her third glass of wine.

scenes.title: Katya Rejects Both of Them
scenes.summary: Katya sharply turns down both Nikita and Denis one after the other, leaving the two men to complain to each other at the bar without naming her.

scenes.title: Eleonora Cancels the New Menu
scenes.summary: Denis thinks Nikita is dating Sveta while Nikita thinks Denis is dating Katya, and Eleonora arrives furious about the prefect and bans Barinov's new menu.

scenes.title: Rollerblade Lesson and the Call from Smak
scenes.summary: Kostya teaches Lyova his rollerblading kiss move, and Barinov receives a phone call inviting his restaurant and new auteur menu onto Channel One's cooking show.

scenes.title: One Good Turn Deserves Another
scenes.summary: Mikhail persuades Barinov to host the TV shoot tomorrow behind Eleonora's back, revealing that Mikhail staged the call to repay Barinov's kindness.

scenes.title: A Lie for Mom and Preparing for the Shoot
scenes.summary: Lyova lies to his mother so he can take Gulya rollerblading in the park, while in the closed restaurant the chefs select the prettiest vegetables for television.

scenes.title: Coffee Invitation and Rollerblade Fall
scenes.summary: Nikita arranges a coffee date with Sveta on Denis's behalf, while in the park Lyova tries to rollerblade with Gulya and crashes.

scenes.title: Lyova and Gulya's First Kiss
scenes.summary: Gulya worries Lyova is ashamed of her background when he hides from his mother, so Lyova tells her she is the most beautiful girl in the world and kisses her.

scenes.title: Mix-Up on the Date
scenes.summary: Denis and Nikita realize their mix-up when both Sveta and Katya arrive for coffee, and the two rivals nearly come to blows over Katya.

scenes.title: Officials Arrive Instead of Television
scenes.summary: While Barinov waits in vain for the TV crew, Eleonora arrives with the deputy mayor and the prefect, sparking a clash with Barinov over the auteur menu.

scenes.title: The Prefect Is Dismissed
scenes.summary: The prefect threatens to close the restaurant unless Barinov is fired, until the deputy mayor informs the prefect that the mayor has removed him from office.

scenes.title: Barinov's Ultimatum
scenes.summary: Eleonora asks Barinov to stay after the prefect's downfall, and accepts Barinov's condition that his new auteur menu remain in place so he can win a Michelin star.
